studies.title: Loud & Clear 2025
studies.claim: In 2024, Spotify alone paid out $10 billion to the music industry—more than any single company has ever contributed in one year.

source.label: Spotify newsroom, Loud & Clear 2025 post (Mar 12, 2025); company-reported, not in the 20-F. The live Loud & Clear site now shows 2025 data (more than $11 billion paid in 2025).
source.quote: In 2024, Spotify alone paid out $10 billion to the music industry—more than any single company has ever contributed in one year.

ecosystem.notes: The 20-F states no total for royalties paid to rights holders: it says "Cost of revenue consists predominantly of royalty and distribution costs related to content streaming" but does not break royalties out, so payouts is null. The $10 billion is Spotify's own figure from its Loud & Clear 2025 report, in US dollars (the filing reports in euros), and is money paid to the music industry as a whole (rights holders such as labels and publishers, not only artists; the Loud & Clear site says its lifetime total "includes both recording and publishing royalties"). It is not audited filing data. No volume measure exists, so measure is null.

notes: Ecosystem lens only. The Loud & Clear figure is stored under studies because it is company-reported and in USD, while the filing is in EUR.
